item.title: ०१७ शूर्पणखा-आगमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Shuurpanakha, the problem demoness of Ramayana enters here. She approaches the cottage of Rama and offers her wifehood to Rama. She is the sister of Ravana and her husband Vidyut Jihva was murdered by Ravana alone, rendering his own sister a widow. She being an age-old demoness wants Rama to marry her, leaving Seetha off.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामके आश्रममें शूर्पणखाका आना, उनका परिचय जानना और अपना परिचय देकर उनसे अपनेको भार्याके रूपमें ग्रहण करनेके लिये अनुरोध करना

item.title: ०१८ शूर्पणखाशासनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama averts Shuurpanakha’s advances toward him and asks her to seek Lakshmana instead. Lakshmana uses wordplay in retorting her in her own words. But she takes the apparent meaning of Lakshmana’s words and rushes to eat away Seetha. Lakshmana defaces her and she noisily runs away from there, only to report to her brother Khara, a violent demon. This is the triggering situation of another round of troubles to Rama and Ramayana.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामके टाल देनेपर शूर्पणखाका लक्ष्मणसे प्रणययाचना करना, फिर उनके भी टालनेपर उसका सीतापर आक्रमण और लक्ष्मणका उसके नाक-कान काट लेना

item.title: ०१९ खराय अङ्गवैरूप्यकथनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Shuurpanakha narrates her woeful story to her brother Khara ncriminating Seetha in particular. She wants Khara to wage a war so that she could drink Seetha’s blood. Khara in order to appease his sister sends fourteen demons to eliminate Rama.

भागसूचना
  1. शूर्पणखाके मुखसे उसकी दुर्दशाका वृत्तान्त सुनकर क्रोधमें भरे हुए खरका श्रीराम आदिके वधके लिये चौदह राक्षसोंको भेजना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Seeing his blood-drenched, mutilated sister lying on the ground, wrathful Khara bids Śūrpaṇakhā rise and demands to know what fool has poked a venomous black cobra and drunk deadly poison.

item.title: ०२० चतुर्दश खरामात्यवधः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

The fourteen demons arrive at Rama’s cottage guided by Shuurpanakha and they wage a war with Rama in which Rama destructs all their weaponry and eliminates them all. Seeing this defeat Shuurpanakha rushes back to her brother to report the defeat.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामद्वारा खरके भेजे हुए चौदह राक्षसोंका वध
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Pointing out Rāma, Sītā, and Lakṣmaṇa in the leaf-thatched cottage, the dreadful Śūrpaṇakhā sets the fourteen demons upon them, whereupon Rāma stations Lakṣmaṇa beside Sītā and strings his gold-adorned bow.

item.title: ०२१ खरान्तिके शूर्पणखाशोकः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Shuurpanakha comes again to her brother Khara to report that all the fourteen demons sent by him are slain by Rama. She persuades him to wage a war against Rama and Lakshmana and annihilate them for they intruded into Dandaka and there is every possibility of onslaught by them on demons.

भागसूचना
  1. शूर्पणखाका खरके पास आकर उन राक्षसोंके वधका समाचार बताना और रामका भय दिखाकर उसे युद्धके लिये उत्तेजित करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Seeing Śūrpaṇakhā writhing on the ground once again, Khara demands to know why she weeps when fourteen invincible warriors have already been dispatched to avenge her.

item.title: ०२२ खरस्य युद्धसिद्धता
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Khara, the brother of Shuurpanakha starts out to wage war with Rama with fourteen thousand demons and with their unusual arsenal. This is the first major move of demons towards Rama that leads to the ultimate battle at the end of epic.

भागसूचना
  1. चौदह हजार राक्षसोंकी सेनाके साथ खर-दूषणका जनस्थानसे पञ्चवटीकी ओर प्रस्थान
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Stung by Śūrpaṇakhā’s taunts, Khara boils over like the surging salt ocean, vowing to fell Rāma with his battle-axe so that his sister may drink the prince’s warm blood.

item.title: ०२३ खरेणोत्पातदर्शनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda -The Forest Trek

On the starting out of Khara’s demonic forces to wage a war with Rama, many bad omens are foreboded by vultures, animals, and even by nature. Though in the know of the portent evil, Khara proceeds with his army vaingloriously messaging his army that he can overcome these auguries or even Indra, and Rama is nothing before him.

भागसूचना
  1. भयंकर उत्पातोंको देखकर भी खरका उनकी परवा नहीं करना तथा राक्षस-सेनाका श्रीरामके आश्रमके समीप पहुँचना

item.title: ०२४ रामस्य युद्धोद्योगः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama perceives good omens of victory, but to safeguard Seetha he sends her away with Lakshmana to take shelter in a mountain’s cave till the war is over. Then he adopts a furious nature to annihilate demons. Gods and divinities watch from heavens as to how a war can occur between one against fourteen thousand demons.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका तात्कालिक शकुनोंद्वारा राक्षसोंके विनाश और अपनी विजयकी सम्भावना करके सीतासहित लक्ष्मणको पर्वतकी गुफामें भेजना और युद्धके लिये उद्यत होना

item.title: ०२५ रामेण खरसैन्यसंहारः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

The ambidextrous archery of Rama is established here for the first time. So far, he has been using his archery sporadically, and here it is said to have a different dimension. The speed with which he draws arrows from quiver, the quickness with which he strings them, and the precision with which he shoots, is suggested here, though not explained. Though no apparent divinity is attached to this excercise, it suggests a divine expertise of a human.

There are fourteen thousand demons against one Rama, and the Divine beings watch this from heavens as a sport, without according any miraculous powers to Rama, suggesting that a human has to face any number of problems, here fourteen thousand demons, for himself and no divine grace suddenly comes to his help.

Rama gives the demons enough time and warning, but as the atrocity is escalating, he uses one gandharva missile and many other arrows, which will devastate the entire army of Dushana’s brute force.

भागसूचना
  1. राक्षसोंका श्रीरामपर आक्रमण और श्रीरामचन्द्रजीके द्वारा राक्षसोंका संहार

item.title: ०२६ दूषणवधः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama eliminates fourteen thousand demons led by Duushana. Firstly, the forerunning demons are killed, next Duushana is routed, and then twelve other captains who on knowing Duushana’s downfall dashed towards Rama. Left behind are only two, Khara and Trishira, the chiefs of that demonic force in Janasthaana.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामके द्वारा दूषणसहित चौदह सहस्र राक्षसोंका वध
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

When Dūṣaṇa’s five thousand warriors pelt Rāma with trees, boulders, and arrows, Rāma calmly receives the downpour like a bull in the rain and overwhelms the host.

item.title: ०२७ त्रिशिरो वधः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Trishira, the demon, supersedes Khara to fight Rama at his turn. He hits Rama with arrows for which Rama says that it is no more than the patting with flowers. Then a combat ensues and Rama becoming infuriated eliminates Trishira in the battle.

भागसूचना
  1. त्रिशिराका वध
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Approaching Khara as he advances against Rāma, the army commander Triśiras vows upon his weapon to slay Rāma in single combat and receives Khara’s permission to attack.

item.title: ०२८ राम-खरयुद्धम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Khara the demon brother of Shuurpanakha confronts Rama when all of his valiant warriors are eliminated. He wages a fearful war showing all his expertise and he even brings down the amour of Rama with his arrows. The combat of Rama and Khara takes a longer time, as Khara is not easy-to-deal demon.

भागसूचना
  1. खरके साथ श्रीरामका घोर युद्ध

item.title: ०२९ खरनिर्भर्त्सनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Khara provokes Rama to fight, but Rama gives enough advise to Khara to yield up. Khara presumes that Rama is overtired to fight him back and thus enters into verbal fight. Ultimately Khara hurls a mammoth mace at Rama, which burns down all the neighbouring plants and bushes, and Rama splinters it down while it is still sky rocketing.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका खरको फटकारना तथा खरका भी उन्हें कठोर उत्तर देकर उनके ऊपर गदाका प्रहार करना और श्रीरामद्वारा उस गदाका खण्डन

item.title: ०३० खरवधः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama and Khara exchange a haughty wordy duel and when the demon Khara charges at Rama, Rama eliminates him with his all-powerful arrow and gods and sages shower flowery rain. Seetha and Lakshmana return from their hiding cave and Seetha becomes very happy on seeing her victorious and indefatigable husband.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामके व्यङ्ग करनेपर खरका उन्हें फटकारकर उनके ऊपर सालवृक्षका प्रहार करना, श्रीरामका उस वृक्षको काटकर एक तेजस्वी बाणसे खरको मार गिराना तथा देवताओं और महर्षियोंद्वारा श्रीरामकी प्रशंसा
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Having shattered Khara’s mace with his shafts, Rāma derides his empty boasts and vows to snatch away his life like Garuḍa seizing the ambrosia.
